claim.claim-text: 1. A method for indicating a sanitation status of a surface (204), the method comprising:

contacting a coating (202) on a surface (204) with a cleaning composition (210), wherein the coating (202) comprises a chromic material comprising core-shell nanoparticles which exhibit a clear baseline optical state under illumination with visible light prior to contact with the cleaning composition (210) and an altered colored optical state under illumination with visible light after contact with the cleaning composition (210) , the cleaning composition (210) configured to induce a switch from the clear baseline optical state to the altered colored optical state; and illuminating the coating (202) with visible light to reveal a sanitation status of the surface (204).
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the core-shell nanoparticles comprise a poly(methyl methacrylate) core and a poly(ethyl acrylate)-co-poly(benzyl methacrylate) shell.
3. The method of any preceding claim, further comprising applying the chromic material to the surface (204) to form the coating (202) thereon.
4. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the switch from the baseline optical state to the altered optical state is reversible.
5. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the altered optical state is maintained for at least 30 minutes.
6. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the coating (202) is in the form of a pre-defined image.
7. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the surface (204) is part of an internal cabin (206) of a vehicle
8. The method of claim 7, wherein the vehicle is an aerospace vehicle.
9. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein the cleaning composition (202) is configured to eliminate a pathogen on the surface (204).
10. A system (200) for indicating a sanitation status of a surface (204), the system (200) comprising:
a coating (202) for applying to a surface (204); and a cleaning composition (210); and wherein:

the coating (202) comprises a chromic material comprising core-shell nanoparticles which exhibit a clear baseline optical state under illumination with visible light prior to contact with the cleaning composition (210) and an altered colored optical state under illumination with visible light after contact with the cleaning composition (210); and the cleaning composition (210) is configured to induce a switch from the clear baseline optical state to the altered colored optical state.
11. The system (200) of claim 10, wherein the core-shell nanoparticles comprise a poly(methyl methacrylate) core and a poly(ethyl acrylate)-co-poly(benzyl methacrylate) shell.
12. The system (200) of claim 10 or 11, further comprising one or more light sources (208) configured to illuminate the coating (202) with visible light.
13. A vehicle comprising the system (200) of any of claims 10-12 and an internal cabin (206) having the surface (204).
14. The vehicle of claim 13, wherein the vehicle is an aerospace vehicle.
15. The vehicle of claim 13 or 14, wherein the surface (204) is coated with the coating (202).
